solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Passport — or search warrant?

definitions.meaning: a document allowing its holder into a country
taken literally, a warrant lets officers go into premises, so it is a licence to get in

explanation.definitionFit: A passport and a search warrant both grant official leave to go in somewhere, one to a country, one to a house.

clue.text: Issue call-up to rising Greek character

indicators.note: in a down clue 'up' tells us to read the word for call from the bottom upwards

parts.note: to call someone something is to name them

indicators.note: rising in a down entry means the Greek letter is written bottom to top

parts.note: eta is the seventh letter of the Greek alphabet

explanation.surface: Someone issues a military call-up to an ambitious Greek.
explanation.walkthrough: 'call-up' looks like one noun meaning conscription, but splits into a word for call with 'up' turning it in this down entry; 'rising' likewise turns the Greek letter.
explanation.definitionFit: To issue and to emanate both mean to come forth or flow out from a source.

clue.text: The Pope's top gear

parts.note: 'top gear' sounds like the best clothes or a car's highest ratio, but means headwear: the crown once worn by popes

explanation.definitionFit: The papal crown is a triple-tiered jewelled headpiece, literally the gear worn on the Pope's top.

clue.text: Cathy built career in sporting competition

indicators.note: the letters of the name are constructed into a new word, as a builder assembles materials

parts.note: taken as written
to career is to rush along at speed, to race

explanation.surface: A woman named Cathy has built a career in sport.
explanation.walkthrough: 'career' looks like a noun for a profession but is the verb meaning to rush, giving RACE; 'built' turns CATHY into YACHT.
explanation.definitionFit: A contest between sailing boats is a sporting competition held on the water.

clue.text: It's bad to be overthrown

indicators.note: something overthrown is upended, so in a down entry the word is written bottom to top

parts.note: to be is to exist or live

explanation.surface: It is a bad thing to be toppled from power.
explanation.walkthrough: 'It's' is a link; the definition is just 'bad'.
explanation.definitionFit: Evil means wicked or morally bad, a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: People cannot recollect having bad ones

definitions.text: People cannot recollect having bad ones

parts.words: People cannot recollect having bad ones
parts.note: reads like a comment on unpleasant experiences, but people with a bad faculty of recall simply cannot recollect: the things they would recall

explanation.definitionFit: Someone said to have a bad memory cannot recollect things, so 'bad ones' are poor powers of recall.

clue.text: Put your foot down to obtain new trade

indicators.note: a new version of the word is made by reordering its letters

explanation.surface: Be firm in order to win new business.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Put your foot down' suggests insisting, but here it is literal: stepping.
explanation.definitionFit: To tread is to step, literally putting one's foot down on the ground.

clue.text: He takes obstacles in his stride

definitions.text: He takes obstacles in his stride

parts.words: He takes obstacles in his stride
parts.note: the idiom means coping calmly with difficulties, but literally describes an athlete clearing barriers mid-stride

explanation.definitionFit: An athlete in the hurdles race leaps barriers without breaking stride, literally taking obstacles in his stride.

clue.text: It currently controls others at building

indicators.note: the letters are assembled into a new construction

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Something controls other people at a building site.
explanation.walkthrough: 'currently' means 'by an electric current', not 'at present'; 'building' rearranges only 'others'.
explanation.definitionFit: A variable resistor controls the flow of electric current in a circuit, as in a dimmer switch.

clue.text: The uncertain chairman's lack of control

indicators.note: letters in an uncertain state are unsettled, so they are rearranged

parts.note: the possessive S is used as a letter here

explanation.surface: A hesitant chairman loses control of the meeting.
explanation.definitionFit: Anarchism is the political creed rejecting government, an absence of rule or control.

clue.text: Number three is wrong

indicators.note: letters that are wrong are out of place, signalling a rearrangement

explanation.surface: Someone claims that the number three is incorrect.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Number' is read as something that numbs, not a figure.
explanation.definitionFit: Ether was an early anaesthetic, so it is something that makes patients numb.

clue.text: Stays will alter a waist

indicators.note: altering the letters changes their order

explanation.surface: Corsets will change the shape of a waist.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stays' looks like corsetry, fitting the waist, but is the verb meaning waits for.
explanation.definitionFit: To stay for something is to wait for it, so stays means expects or waits for.

clue.text: Well brought up, but lacking refinement?

definitions.text: Well brought up, but lacking refinement?

parts.words: Well brought up, but lacking refinement?
parts.note: seems to describe a poorly mannered person of good upbringing, but means petroleum pumped up from a well before processing

explanation.definitionFit: Unrefined petroleum is raised from an oil well and has not yet been through a refinery.

clue.text: Former star played walk-on characters

parts.note: ex means former, as in ex-wife

indicators.note: the letters are played with, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A one-time star ended up playing bit parts.
explanation.definitionFit: Film extras are background actors with walk-on roles and no lines.

clue.text: Understood vessel could be reserved

parts.note: tacit means understood without being stated
an urn is a vessel or vase

explanation.surface: It was understood that the ship could be booked.
explanation.walkthrough: 'vessel' suggests a ship and 'reserved' a booking; neither sense applies.
explanation.definitionFit: A taciturn person is reserved, saying little and keeping their thoughts to themselves.

clue.text: Can't serve venison without bottle of wine

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the meat surrounds the other piece

parts.note: venison is the meat of deer
the word without its apostrophe

explanation.surface: Diners cannot be served venison unless there is a bottle of wine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'serve' is a link word between the pieces; 'without' means outside, not lacking.
explanation.definitionFit: A decanter is a glass vessel into which wine is poured from its bottle for serving.

clue.text: A time to receive praise for virtue

parts.note: a tribute is an expression of praise

explanation.surface: A time comes to receive praise for one's goodness.
explanation.definitionFit: An attribute is a quality or characteristic, and a virtue is a good quality.

clue.text: Brewed ale round there is heavenly!

indicators.note: the anagrammed letters go round the other word
brewing mixes ingredients, so the letters are stirred into a new order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Beer brewed around here tastes divine!
explanation.walkthrough: 'Brewed' turns the beer into EAL, and 'round' wraps those letters about 'there'; the exclamation mark just adds surface relish.
explanation.definitionFit: Ethereal means of the heavens or celestial, delicate and otherworldly.

clue.text: Greeks and Romans are different for instance

indicators.note: the letters are made different by being reordered

explanation.surface: Greeks and Romans differ, for example.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for' is a link word; only 'instance' is rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: The ancients are the peoples of classical antiquity, chiefly the Greeks and Romans.

clue.text: Stubborn Old Testament character has a New Testament following

parts.note: Adam is the first man in Genesis

explanation.surface: An obstinate Old Testament figure gains followers in the New Testament.
explanation.definitionFit: Adamant describes someone who refuses to be persuaded, unyieldingly stubborn.

clue.text: Still, it could affect one's reception

definitions.meaning: electrical interference crackling on a radio or television signal

explanation.definitionFit: Static means stationary, and atmospheric static is interference that spoils broadcast reception.

clue.text: Rising singer joining company, a capital investment

indicators.note: the singer links up with the company, which comes first in the answer
rising in a down entry means the singer is written bottom to top

parts.note: a tenor is a high male singer

explanation.surface: An up-and-coming singer joins a firm, an important financial investment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'capital' means of the head, and 'investment' means something invested in or put on, not a financial outlay.
explanation.definitionFit: A small crown is worn on the head, so it is something put on the head, playing on capital as head.

clue.text: Rate rise for renovating major roads

indicators.note: renovating rebuilds, so the letters are rebuilt in a new order

explanation.surface: Rates go up to pay for repairing the main roads.
explanation.walkthrough: 'major roads' suggests highways but here means main routes of any network, such as blood vessels.
explanation.definitionFit: Arterial roads are main highways, and arteries is used for major traffic routes.

clue.text: Get up about mid-morning and wash

indicators.note: the first word goes about the middle letter

parts.note: to rise is to get up
the middle letter of morning

explanation.surface: Get out of bed around mid-morning and have a wash.
explanation.definitionFit: To rinse is to wash lightly in clean water.

clue.text: Glass-paper?

parts.note: looks like sandpaper, but splits into a looking-glass that is also the name of a British tabloid newspaper

explanation.definitionFit: A looking-glass is a reflecting surface, and the Daily Mirror is a UK daily tabloid newspaper.

clue.text: Gather together for hike

definitions.meaning: as in collecting an army or funds
an increase, as in a pay hike

explanation.definitionFit: One raises an army or money by gathering it, and an American pay raise is a hike.

clue.text: Dismal party game is upsetting

parts.note: a do is a party

indicators.note: upsetting tips something over, so the letters are turned upside down in a down entry

parts.note: RU is rugby union

explanation.surface: A gloomy party game is distressing.
explanation.walkthrough: RU (rugby union, the British fifteen-a-side football code) is turned to give UR.
explanation.definitionFit: Dour means gloomy, sullen and severe, close to dismal.

clue.text: Front cover

definitions.meaning: the part of a theatre stage in front of the curtain
a garment worn over clothes to protect them

explanation.definitionFit: A stage's forward part is its apron, and a cook wears one as a protective covering.

clue.text: Live out on new development

indicators.note: a new arrangement of the letters is made

explanation.surface: Living out on a new housing development.
explanation.definitionFit: Evolution is gradual development, as of species over time.

clue.text: Expansion of the novel 'Greenmantle'

indicators.note: as an adjective novel means new, so the letters take a new order

explanation.surface: An expanded edition of John Buchan's novel Greenmantle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'novel' looks like a noun, as Greenmantle is a John Buchan novel, but is the adjective meaning new.
explanation.definitionFit: An enlargement is an expansion, a making bigger.
